from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    row_cells = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1) if row_bounds[i + 1] > row_bounds[i] + 1]
    col_cells = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1) if col_bounds[i + 1] > col_bounds[i] + 1]
    line_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in row_lines} | {grid[0][c] for c in col_lines}
    colors = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            if value not in line_colors:
                colors[value] = colors.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(colors, key=colors.get)
    best = None
    best_count = -1
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_cells):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_cells):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            if count > best_count:
                best, best_count = (ri, ci), count
    sr0, sr1 = row_cells[best[0]]
    sc0, sc1 = col_cells[best[1]]
    motif = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in row_cells:
        for c0, c1 in col_cells:
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = motif[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-09e17784.py'
path.write_text(code)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task09',path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
test=[[1,1,1,4,1,1,1,4,1,1,1] for _ in range(17)]
for r in (5,11): test[r]=[4]*11
for r,c,v in [(6,2,7),(7,0,9),(8,1,7)]: test[r][c]=v
out=mod.transform(test)
print(out)
# verify given demo pair
D=[[6,6,2,1,1],[8,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[2,2,2,2,2],[1,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[2,2,2,2,2],[1,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[1,1,2,1,1]]
expected=[[6,6,2,6,6],[8,1,2,8,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[2,2,2,2,2],[6,6,2,6,6],[8,1,2,8,1],[1,1,2,1,1],[2,2,2,2,2],[6,6,2,6,6],[8,1,2,8,1],[1,1,2,1,1]]
print('demo matches',mod.transform(D)==expected)
